description: This file contains React components and logic for managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup steps, including selecting authenticators, configuring apps, email, SMS, handling recovery codes, and enabling fallback methods within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: ChooseAuthenticator
classes.description: Component for selecting MFA authentication method.

classes.name: AuthenticatorSelector
classes.description: Component for configuring selected MFA authenticator.

classes.name: SetupAuthenticatorApp
classes.description: Component for setting up authenticator app (e.g., QR code).

classes.name: SetupEmail
classes.description: Component for setting up email MFA.

classes.name: SetupSMS
classes.description: Component for setting up SMS MFA.

classes.name: BackupRecoveryCodes
classes.description: Component for displaying and managing recovery codes.

classes.name: TwoFactorEnabled
classes.description: Component indicating MFA has been enabled.

classes.name: Fallback2FAEnabled
classes.description: Component indicating fallback MFA method has been enabled.

classes.name: VerifyAuthenticatorForm
classes.description: Form component for entering MFA verification code.

methods.name: mfaMethodToPhrase
methods.description: Converts MFA method type to descriptive phrase.
